title: Phrasal verbs 9 away/back
subtitle: away = прочь, back = обратно: give away, pay back, call back…

head: away
back
rows: прочь из дома: go away — уехать (в отпуск и т.п.)
прочь от места/человека: walk / run / drive / fly / look away
give / take / put something back — вернуть, положить обратно

items: put something away — убрать на место; throw something away — выбросить.
get away — сбежать, удрать; get away with something — сойти с рук.
wave / smile / shout back, hit somebody back — ответить тем же.
call / phone / ring somebody back — перезвонить; get back to somebody — ответить позже.
pay back money / pay somebody back — вернуть долг.

theory.text: «Верни мне книгу» — Give me the book back или Give it back to me, а не Return back: в return «обратно» уже заложено. И местоимение снова в середине: pay it back, put them away.

en: We're going away for the weekend.
We are going away this weekend.

items.ru: Она села в такси и уехала.
en: She got into a taxi and drove away.
She got in a taxi and drove away.
She got into a taxi and drove off.
The bird flew away when I came closer.
The bird flew away when I got closer.
The bird flew away when I approached.

items.ru: Не отворачивайся, когда я с тобой разговариваю.
en: Don't look away when I'm talking to you.
Don't look away when I'm speaking to you.
The waiter took away our plates.
The waiter took our plates away.
I'll be back in an hour.
I'll come back in an hour.
What time did you get back yesterday?
What time did you come back yesterday?

items.ru: После концерта мы пошли пешком обратно в гостиницу.
en: After the concert we walked back to the hotel.
Give me back my phone!
Give me my phone back!
Give my phone back!
Put the scissors back in the drawer.
Put the scissors back into the drawer.
Keep away from the edge.
Stay away from the edge.
Keep away from my car!
Stay away from my car!

items.ru: Я отдал все свои старые книги.
en: I gave away all my old books.
I gave all my old books away.

items.ru: (о гитаре) Нет, я её не продал, а отдал другу.
en: No, I didn't sell it, I gave it away to a friend.
No, I didn't sell it, I gave it to a friend.
Put your things away, please.
Please put your things away.
Put away your things, please.
Don't throw away this box.
Don't throw this box away.
The thief got away through the window.
The thief escaped through the window.

items.ru: Он соврал учителю, и ему это сошло с рук.
en: He lied to the teacher and got away with it.

items.ru: Я улыбнулся ребёнку, и он улыбнулся в ответ.
en: I smiled at the child and he smiled back.
I smiled at the child and she smiled back.
I smiled at the baby and he smiled back.
I smiled at the kid and he smiled back.

items.ru: Я сейчас занят, я перезвоню тебе позже.
en: I'm busy now, I'll call you back later.
I'm busy now, I'll phone you back later.
I'm busy right now, I'll call you back later.
I'm busy at the moment, I'll call you back later.

items.ru: Я отправил им анкету, но они мне так и не ответили.
en: I sent them the form, but they never got back to me.

items.ru: Вспоминая те годы, я понимаю, что был счастлив.
en: Looking back on those years, I realise I was happy.
Looking back on those years, I realize I was happy.

items.ru: Спасибо за деньги, я верну тебе долг завтра.
en: Thanks for the money, I'll pay you back tomorrow.
Thank you for the money, I'll pay you back tomorrow.
Thanks for the money, I'll pay it back tomorrow.
When will you pay me back?
When are you going to pay me back?
When will you pay the money back?
When will you give me the money back?
When are you going to give me the money back?
